items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: That fellow with the John took out, I played Albert, big sheet.

ctx.x: Yeah. No, I never was down.

That fellow with the John took out, I played Albert, big sheet. Slow drag. That's all. That's all. That fellow would get short. There'd be anybody that would get up in the water, you know, in your dress, you see. They'd come get you.
I was going to ask a little bit more about the old style drum sets. When you started, they didn't use the sock cymbal, I guess, then, did they?
